name: Office Automator
name_vn: Tự động hóa tài liệu Office
description: Read, create, or modify Microsoft Office documents (Word docx, Excel xlsx, PowerPoint pptx) using OfficeCLI.

action.description: Action to perform: 'create' (create blank file), 'dump' (extract text/data), 'merge' (fill template with data).

file_path.description: Path to the target Office document or template file.

output_path.description: Path to the output file (required for merge, optional for dump).

data.description: JSON object of data for merge templates (e.g. {'name':'John'}).
